year_display.en: Lecture to working men at Norwich, 1868
year_display.zh: 1868 年在诺里奇为工人所作的讲演

edition.en: Lay Sermons, Addresses and Reviews (London: Macmillan, 1870), as transcribed by Project Gutenberg (eBook 16729); the lecture complete, without Huxley's footnotes.
edition.zh: 据《俗人讲道、演说与评论集》（伦敦：麦克米伦，1870 年），以古腾堡计划电子书第 16729 号为底本；讲演全文，略去赫胥黎的脚注。

basis.en: Delivered in 1868 and published in 1868 and 1870; the author died in 1895.
basis.zh: 1868 年讲演，1868 年与 1870 年发表；作者卒于 1895 年。

note.en: Huxley gave this lecture to the working men of Norwich during a meeting of the British Association, holding up the chalk every carpenter keeps in his pocket. From it he reads, step by step and with evidence a listener could check, a seabed of microscopic shells, an ocean where England now stands, and a history of the earth told in rock. Notice the last paragraph: put the chalk into a hydrogen flame and it shines like the sun, which is what an hour of patient thought has done to it.
note.zh: 赫胥黎在英国科学促进会开会期间，给诺里奇的工人们作了这次讲演，手里举着每个木匠都揣在兜里的那种白垩。他从这一小块东西里，一步一步、用听众自己可以核对的证据，读出了一片由微小贝壳铺成的海底，一个曾经覆盖着今天英格兰的海洋，以及一部写在岩石里的地球历史。请留意最后一段：把白垩放进氢气的火焰里，它会像太阳一样发光——一个小时耐心的思考，对它做的正是这件事。

excerpt.orig: A great chapter of the history of the world is written in the chalk.
excerpt.en: A great chapter of the history of the world is written in the chalk.
excerpt.zh: 世界历史的伟大一章，就写在白垩里。

gloss.en: An ancient name for Britain, often connected with Latin albus, white, for the chalk cliffs seen from the Continent.
gloss.zh: 不列颠的古称，常被认为与拉丁文 albus（白色）有关，指从欧洲大陆望得见的白垩悬崖。

gloss.en: A genus of foraminifera, single-celled organisms that build chambered shells of calcium carbonate. Huxley argues below that they live on the deep floor; later work showed that they drift near the surface and their empty shells sink.
gloss.zh: 抱球虫属，一类有孔虫：单细胞生物，用碳酸钙造出分室的壳。赫胥黎在下文中认为它们生活在深海底；后来的研究表明，它们漂浮在海面附近，死后空壳才沉到海底。

gloss.at: the telegraph-cable between this country and the United States
gloss.en: The first transatlantic telegraph cable was completed in August 1858 and failed within weeks; a lasting one was laid in 1866.
gloss.zh: 第一条横跨大西洋的电报电缆于 1858 年 8 月接通，几周后就失效了；1866 年才铺成一条持久可用的电缆。

gloss.en: A fathom is six feet, so 1,700 fathoms is about 3,100 metres.
gloss.zh: 一英寻合六英尺，1700 英寻约合 3100 米。

gloss.en: Tiny plates of calcite made by single-celled algae, the coccolithophores. Much of the chalk’s fine granular matter is made of them.
gloss.zh: 颗石，由单细胞藻类颗石藻造出的微小方解石片；白垩中那些细微的颗粒，很大一部分就是它们。

gloss.at: the whirligig of time brought its revenges
gloss.en: From the clown Feste in Shakespeare’s Twelfth Night: “and thus the whirligig of time brings in his revenges.”
gloss.zh: 出自莎士比亚《第十二夜》中小丑费斯特的台词：“时间的陀螺就这样转来了它的报应。”

gloss.en: A motto of Goethe’s, “Ohne Hast, aber ohne Rast”.
gloss.zh: 歌德的格言：“不慌不忙，却也从不停息”（Ohne Hast, aber ohne Rast）。
